component.name: Ferritone
component.summary: Play and organize your local music collection
Reproduza e organize sua coleção local de músicas

description.p: Ferritone is a music player for local audio files. Search your library, build playlists by dragging files and folders, and resume your playback queue after restarting the app.
O Ferritone é um reprodutor de arquivos de áudio locais. Busque na sua biblioteca, crie listas de reprodução arrastando arquivos ou pastas e retome a fila ao reabrir o aplicativo.
The mini player can show album art, live audio visualizations, and optional lyrics. Ferritone also provides a ten-band equalizer, ReplayGain, and desktop media controls.
O miniplayer pode exibir a capa do álbum, visualizações de áudio e letras opcionais. O Ferritone também oferece equalizador de dez bandas, ReplayGain e controles de mídia integrados ao sistema.

description.p: Tap the cover on the remote to see the lyrics, synchronized with the current line highlighted. The sidebar stays hidden at startup when turned off, and the playback menu opens in narrow windows.
On phones, the remote's player fills the first screen and the lists start below it, and a full screen button hides the browser's address bar.

Add the remote control to a phone or tablet's home screen: a button at the bottom of the remote page explains how in Chrome on Android and Safari on iPhone and iPad, and the shortcut gets Ferritone's name and icon and opens straight into the player.

Uses far less memory by drawing the interface in software, with an option to use the graphics card instead. The mini player is redesigned: with lyrics the cover becomes a thumbnail and the lyrics fill a card, the waveform is a strip in the accent color, and three new visualizations join it: a pulsing ring, an LED meter, and an aurora. Preferences shows whether ListenBrainz is connected and how many listens it has recorded, and Home can play your most played tracks on ListenBrainz. Messages can be closed and go away on their own, and slider knobs no longer look selected at rest.

A refined look: the sidebar shows icons and marks the page you are on, the playback bar and mini player use round controls with the play button in the accent color and slim sliders, and track lists are softer and rounder. The phone and tablet remote is redesigned, with a blurred cover backdrop, covers and lengths in every list, and the playing track marked by animated bars. Its progress bar no longer freezes after a touch turns into a scroll.

Control Ferritone from a phone or tablet: scan a QR code to play, pause, skip, seek, and browse the queue, the whole library, and playlists in the browser, or play the music on that device itself. On the computer, the same page opens at localhost. Browse the library by album and artist with covers, play smart lists of recently added, recently played, and most played tracks, and let tracks follow each other without a gap. New folders and files in the library appear on their own. A sleep timer pauses playback, the screen and computer stay awake while music plays, listens can be sent to ListenBrainz, and synchronized lyrics are found for many more songs. The System theme follows the desktop as it changes, and the remote page and dock controls use Ferritone's colors.

Ferritone now uses the app ID io.github.ghsantosalves.Ferritone and can be built as a Flatpak. Your library, playlists, and settings are kept. If you pinned Ferritone to the dock, pin it again after updating.

Plays consecutive tracks without a gap, so live albums and continuous mixes sound as recorded. While playing, the position is now autosaved to a small separate file instead of rewriting the whole library, which avoids stutters with large libraries.

Stops after several tracks in a row fail to play and keeps your place on the first one, avoids saving the library twice when playback starts, and makes the dock menu controls open Ferritone when it is not running.
Skips tracks that cannot be played instead of stopping, saves the playback position every 30 seconds, and adds playback controls to the dock icon menu.
